cells.title: Botox & Xeomin in Westlake, TX | Westlake Medical Aesthetics

props.text: About fifteen minutes, no anesthetic and no downtime. Placed by our nurse practitioner, who usually starts with fewer units than you'd expect.
Pricing depends on the number of units and the areas treated. You'll get a quote at your consultation.

Botox and Xeomin are both botulinum toxin type A, a purified protein that temporarily relaxes the muscle it's placed in. Small amounts in the upper face stop those muscles from creasing the skin, so the lines they cause soften.

It doesn't fill, tighten or remove anything. A line you can still see when your face is completely relaxed is etched into the skin, and Botox alone will only improve it slowly. That's the first thing your provider checks.
What it can do for you
Most people describe how they look rather than what they want done: tired, annoyed, older than they feel. In the upper face, that usually comes down to three muscles.
Forehead lines soften without dropping your brow.
The frown line between your eyebrows stops making you look cross.
Crow's feet ease when you smile.
A heavy brow can lift slightly when the muscle pulling it down relaxes.
Most healthy adults are good candidates. Your consultation is where we confirm that and work out how much you need. For a first treatment, it's usually less than you'd think.

You're pregnant or breastfeeding, have a neuromuscular condition, have an infection where you'd be treated, or your lines are static. In that last case, your provider may suggest a skin treatment or filler instead.

All four are botulinum toxin type A. They differ in how quickly they start, how far they spread and how they behave over years of treatment. Having all four means your provider can choose the one that suits you.
Most first treatments. It has the longest track record and is very predictable in small areas.
Patients whose Botox seems to wear off faster than it used to. Xeomin has no accessory proteins.
Larger areas like a broad forehead, where a wider spread helps.
Your Botox is placed by Brooke, our nurse practitioner injector, after a full assessment. She'll keep your first treatment conservative and see you again at two weeks to check the result.
If your doctor agrees, pause fish oil, vitamin E and high-dose anti-inflammatories for about a week. They can cause bruising.
Skip alcohol for 24 hours beforehand, for the same reason.
Come with a clean face if you can. We'll remove any makeup before we start.
Let us know about recent dental work, vaccinations or illness.
Stay upright for four hours. No lying flat or face-down naps.
Don't rub or massage the treated areas.
Avoid hard workouts, saunas and hot yoga for a day.
Small bumps settle within an hour. A bruise can take a few days.
Judge the result at two weeks, not three days. We'll book your follow-up then.
We're updating our before-and-after gallery. In the meantime, ask to see results for your treatment at your consultation.
The needle is very fine and each injection takes about a second. Most patients describe a quick sting. No anesthetic is needed, and you can drive yourself home.
How soon will I see it?
Movement starts to soften after three to seven days, and the full effect shows at about two weeks. We book your follow-up then.
Not if it's dosed and placed well. We treat the muscles that are creasing the skin and leave the rest working, and we keep first treatments conservative.
What happens when it wears off?
Your muscles gradually go back to how they worked before, and so do the lines. Nothing ends up worse than it was.
How many units will I need?
It depends on your muscles and the areas you want treated, so we can't say over the phone. You'll get your number and a quote after the assessment, before anything is injected.
For volume that has faded rather than lines from movement. Often done at the same visit.

cells.title: Treatments | Westlake Medical Aesthetics, Westlake TX

props.text: Non-invasive treatments that soften lines, restore volume and help your skin make more of its own collagen, so you look your best without surgery. Open any treatment to see how long it takes, when you'll see results and how long they last.

Neuromodulators soften the lines that come from movement, fillers restore volume, and biostimulators like Sculptra help your skin build its own collagen over time. Every injection is done by our nurse practitioner.

Botox and Xeomin relax the muscles that crease the skin, softening forehead lines, frown lines and crow's feet. Xeomin has no accessory proteins, which can help if Botox seems to wear off faster than it used to.
Two more neuromodulators that work the same way as Botox. Dysport spreads a little further, which can suit a larger area like the forehead, and Jeuveau is often chosen for frown lines.
Ask about this treatment at your consultation and we'll go through it with you.

Hyaluronic acid filler restores shape and volume to the lips, cheeks, chin and jawline, and can soften hollows under the eyes. Placement is planned around your facial structure so the result looks like you.
Ask about this treatment at your consultation and we'll go through it with you.
Sculptra is a biostimulator. Instead of filling a space, it prompts your skin to rebuild collagen, so results appear gradually over a few months and can last two years or more.
Volume loss, Laxity & jawline, Texture & pores
Ask about this treatment at your consultation and we'll go through it with you.
These treatments prompt your skin to repair and renew itself. Most are done as a short series, and results keep improving for a few months after the last session.

Radiofrequency energy delivered through fine microneedles tightens and smooths the deeper layers of the skin while leaving the surface largely intact. It works well on the jawline, the neck and acne scarring.
Laxity & jawline, Texture & pores, Acne scarring
Ask about this treatment at your consultation and we'll go through it with you.

A peel lifts away damaged surface skin to even out tone, fade sun spots and refine texture. Light peels have almost no downtime, deeper ones need about a week, and we'll help you pick one that fits your schedule.
Pigmentation & tone, Texture & pores, Dryness & dullness
Ask about this treatment at your consultation and we'll go through it with you.
SkinPen creates thousands of tiny channels in the skin, which starts its natural repair process and boosts collagen. It's a good fit for acne scars, enlarged pores and early fine lines.
Texture & pores, Acne scarring, Fine lines & wrinkles

Cleansing, exfoliation, extractions and hydration in a single treatment. We offer several versions, from 45 to 90 minutes, so your esthetician can match the facial to your skin, and you can go straight back to your day.
